text: Lotty and Nazeem are aiming to observe emotional responses to different films at the cinema. They
have different ideas for recording people’s emotions. Lotty wants to do a structured observation,
with fixed behaviours to record. However, Nazeem wants to do an unstructured observation, and
record whatever behaviours are shown.
